identity.name: Stijn Heemskerk
identity.tagline: intro · Stijn Heemskerk, junior full stack engineer

about.bio: Junior full stack software engineer at Bemmel & Kroon and Software Engineering student at The Hague University of Applied Sciences, from Leiden. I like making things all the way through: the code, but also the icon, the installer, the little sound when something works. Most of my own work ships under Arcnode, my small studio for my own projects and the occasional client. Away from the keyboard I mountain bike, play drums, and there is pretty much always music on.

work.title: Junior Full Stack Software Engineer
work.desc: Web apps and internal tools, front end and back end: turning what the company needs into practical software and automating how work gets done. Includes the staff scheduling app I started in 2025.

work.title: Software Engineering intern
work.desc: An AI-driven content platform for a Dutch hospitality publisher: OpenAI assistants with a human check, cutting content from about a week to one or two days at around 90% accuracy. Front end, back end and design.

work.title: Founder
work.desc: My studio for my own software and client work: desktop apps, a game and its launcher, community platforms and Backboard, the sign-in service behind all of them.

work.title: Customer service and inside sales
work.desc: First point of contact for customers, appliance sales and advice, orders, service requests and complaints. Where I grew into building software.

work.title: Bike courier
work.desc: Meals to the door, by bike, in every kind of Dutch weather.

work.title: Hospitality and retail
work.org: Van der Valk, Grand Café Hofplein, Blokker and more
work.desc: Serving, bar work, kitchen prep, the till and stocking shelves: where I learned how much good contact with people matters.

projects.name: Arcnode
projects.desc: My studio: projects, downloads, a client portal and the sign-in service behind every app.
projects.long: One Turborepo monorepo for the website, Backboard (the OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect account service every Arcnode app signs in with), the game API, the relay for Arcnode Remote, the status page and the community bot. Deployed on Vercel and Railway.

projects.name: Arcnode Remote
projects.desc: Remote support for Windows, end-to-end encrypted, on the other person's terms.
projects.long: Help anyone over the internet with a one-time code. The person at the computer sees who is helping (confirmed by Arcnode), compares a six-digit code and can disconnect at any moment. Sessions are end-to-end encrypted with Noise XX and go through the Arcnode relay over TLS 1.3. View only or full control, every screen at once, chat, file transfer and any-time access.

projects.name: Rosa Wildlife Reserve
projects.desc: The website and five Discord bots behind a Path of Titans realism server.
projects.long: rosarealism.com with a member dashboard, five Discord bots (applications, tickets, player progress, voice) and a desktop app for staff, all in one monorepo on a shared PostgreSQL database that talks to the game server, with tests and releases on GitHub.

projects.name: Vardoxen
projects.desc: The website and Discord bot behind streamer Vardoxen's community.
projects.long: vardoxen.tv and the Citadel Discord bot on one shared database: Discord sign-in, moderated anonymous submissions, giveaways, supporter pages, live alerts and a role-based admin dashboard. The bot is written in Python.

projects.name: Bemmel & Kroon Scheduling
projects.desc: Rosters, absence and staff planning for Bemmel & Kroon, with rights per role.
projects.long: An internal web app where staff, team leads and management handle rosters, absence and staff planning. It started in PHP and MySQL in 2025 and grew into a Next.js platform with Excel and calendar export, email notifications and an installable PWA. The screenshots use made-up names.

projects.name: Exit Only
projects.desc: A 3D police chase through a rainy night city that changes every run.
projects.long: The police only know where you are while someone can see you: break every line of sight around corners, through traffic and under the Plaza Tunnel, and stay out of the helicopter searchlight until they give up. Every run builds a different city with its own closures, hour, weather and traffic. Crashes leave dents and glass on the road, the car drives with gears and real grip, and Rooftop Rush adds a sliding-vehicle puzzle on a gridlocked parking deck. Every car, building and sound is made in-house. Free on Arcnode Games.

projects.name: ArcJournal
projects.desc: A private daily journal for Windows, macOS and Linux, end-to-end encrypted.
projects.long: Write daily entries, tag the mood behind them and grade your days, so patterns show up in your stats. Version 2 encrypts every entry on your computer with AES-256-GCM before it is saved, with a key only your passphrase or recovery key can open. Signs in with Arcnode and updates itself on every platform.

projects.name: Arcnode Games
projects.desc: The launcher that installs, verifies and updates my games.
projects.long: Installs games from signed releases, checks every file against an Ed25519 signature before it runs, and updates games and itself by downloading only what changed. Signing in is optional, and installed games play fully offline. Exit Only is its first title.

projects.name: ArcFlux
projects.desc: Color tracking and physics for projection mapping, in the browser.
projects.long: Tracks color in a live camera feed and drives a physics simulation from it, producing responsive visuals you can project onto real surfaces.

projects.name: ArcUnzip
projects.desc: Open a .zip right in the browser, with nothing uploaded.
projects.long: Drop in an archive and it is unpacked and shown in the browser. Files never leave your device.

projects.name: rosa-vscode
projects.desc: A VS Code theme with Rosa Wildlife Reserve colors, icons and a pixel dinosaur.
projects.long: Colors, file icons and a small pixel dinosaur for the Rosa Wildlife Reserve team, in one VS Code extension.

projects.name: AutoMod badge bot
projects.desc: Sets up AutoMod rules so a Discord bot earns its AutoMod badge.
projects.long: Deploys AutoMod rules across your Discord servers so your bot earns the AutoMod Rule Creator badge.
